name: Cardiac Diet (Heart-Healthy)
description: Illustrative cardiac diet: low saturated fat and sodium. Verify against your institution's diet manual.

rules.title: Saturated fat below 7% of daily calories
rules.source: AHA dietary recommendation: saturated fat under 6-7% of calories for heart health
rules.remedy: Replace cheese, bacon and fatty meats with fish, legumes or lean poultry.

rules.title: Daily sodium at most 2,000 mg
rules.source: AHA: ideal limit 1,500 mg/day, no more than 2,300 mg/day
rules.remedy: Use fresh ingredients and avoid canned or cured foods.

rules.title: No processed meats
rules.source: AHA: limit processed meats (high in sodium and saturated fat)
rules.remedy: Choose skinless poultry, fish or plant proteins.

rules.title: Fibre at least 14 g per 1,000 kcal
rules.source: Dietary Guidelines for Americans: 14 g fibre per 1,000 kcal
rules.remedy: Add whole grains, legumes, vegetables or fruit.

rules.title: Include fish in the plan (at least 100 g/day)
rules.source: AHA: eat fish, especially fatty fish, at least twice a week
rules.remedy: Add a salmon portion to lunch or dinner.
